A large, sudden explosion occurs at a building complex, producing a massive fireball and rapidly expanding dark smoke plume, followed by debris ejection and dust cloud formation.

Secondary detonation or structural collapse continues immediately after the initial blast, evidenced by sustained violent dust and smoke expansion, visible shockwave-like dust front moving outward, and additional debris ejection (e.g., small object flying at f2).

Post-blast effects: rapid dissipation of the initial fireball, transition to dense dust/smoke cloud engulfing the target structure; no further detonations, but ongoing structural settling and dust suspension visible through f15.
